title: [review] worker6-tkjl: duplicate senml_encode_location_full declaration in senml.h
description: Commit be583f03 adds a second declaration of senml_encode_location_full at lichen/subsys/lichen/senml/include/lichen/senml.h:279, duplicating the existing declaration at line 254. The new declaration adds LICHEN_WARN_UNUSED_RESULT and doxygen comments, but having both will cause a compile error (redefinition of function). Fix: add the WARN_UNUSED_RESULT attribute and doxygen to the existing declaration at line 254, and remove the duplicate at line 279. File: lichen/subsys/lichen/senml/include/lichen/senml.h
